drift.change: Set the static improvement numerals 1, 2 and 3 to --tm-ink (#151B23), retaining their current size and alignment. Keep cobalt on the approval action and meaningful selection/proposal edges.
drift.why: These numbers are organizational labels, not actions or selected states. Their cobalt treatment slightly exceeds the approved accent discipline for management screens.
drift.where: The numbered list under “3 ways to make your brand more consistent”

review.why: The supplied Lab image is Content, not a Brand kit design, so fidelity is appropriately judged against its system rather than its media-heavy layout. Production preserves the shell, surfaces, typography, spacing and control treatment while using a quieter, readable management column. Findings lead into a clear current/proposed comparison and then an explicit commitment plane; nothing visually implies that the proposal is already applied. Settings navigation, the permanent rail, preview access and both decision actions remain exposed. No money belongs to this screen, and no unrelated balance or financial hierarchy has been introduced.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift was faithfully transferred to the desktop Brand kit, with the visible approval workflow intact and only minor accent-color polish remaining.
